notes: WIOA programs have federal rules on who qualifies. Ask YDI if you qualify.
name: WIOA Youth Program, Northern Region
city: Santa Fe and northern New Mexico
what_you_do: Free job training with a paid work placement with a local employer. You also get mentors, money skills training and 12 months of follow up help.
who_can_apply: You must be ages 14 to 24. You live in Cibola, Colfax, Los Alamos, McKinley, Mora, Rio Arriba, San Juan, San Miguel, Santa Fe or Taos County. The page lists no other rules.
pay_detail: Paid work experience. Wage not stated.
duration: Year-round support. Paid work experience typically runs 250 to 350 hours.
deadline_text: No deadline. The program runs year-round.
how_to_apply: Contact YDI through the form on the program page or call 505-977-3216 (Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.).
